pages.text: The **Ender Tank** is a hollow box from 3×3×3 up to 8 wide, 10 tall and 8 deep. All edges must be **frames**. The walls may be frames, **glass**, **valves**, **energy inputs** and exactly one **controller**. It needs at least one valve and one energy input, and the inside must be empty.

Each interior block stores **512 buckets**. Moving fluid through a valve costs **1 RF per mB**, paid from the tank's own buffer (up to 10,000,000 RF, filled at up to 20,000 RF/t through energy inputs). Use the controller (or a valve) to see its state and why it is not formed. A Fluid Port on a chassis next to a valve fills and drains it. If the structure breaks, the contents stay in the controller. A broken controller keeps them in its item.
